description: This file defines the Root controller for a Catalyst web application, including route handlers for the homepage, dashboard, about page, and various setup methods. It manages request processing, URL generation, access control, and view rendering.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Root
classes.description: Controller class handling root-level routes and actions for the Coocook web application, including homepage, dashboard, about, and common setup routines.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Handles the base route, enforces HTTPS redirection if necessary.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Initializes common stash variables such as app name, user info, and URLs.

methods.name: auto
methods.description: Performs pre-processing before actions, including session messages, user authentication checks, and setting up view assets.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the root URL ('/') and displays recipes of the day or redirects to dashboard or homepage.

methods.name: homepage
methods.description: Renders the homepage with recent recipes and projects.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Displays user-specific projects and organization info.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Finalizes view rendering, handles access control for submenu items, and sets security headers.

methods.name: _validated_redirect
methods.description: Validates and performs a redirect based on a URL parameter, defaulting to root.
